questions.q: Tu amiga es de Perú. ¿Cómo se dice su nacionalidad?
questions.explanation: Peruana is the feminine form — nationality words ending in -o/-a change for a woman.

questions.q: Which nationality word stays exactly the same whether it describes a man or a woman?
questions.explanation: Estadounidense ends in -ense, and -ense nationality words never change for gender.

questions.q: You want to ask a famous singer where she is from, but you're talking ABOUT her, not TO her. Which question fits?
questions.explanation: ¿De dónde es? is the third-person form, used to ask about someone else rather than speak directly to them.

questions.q: You want to ask a new classmate directly where they are from. Which question fits?
questions.explanation: ¿De dónde eres? uses the tú-form eres, for speaking directly to someone your own age.

questions.q: Which phrase means 'I was born in'?
questions.explanation: Nací en means 'I was born in,' followed by a city or a country.
Nacionalidad is the country a person belongs to — their nationality.
